insert into chatroom(roomNo, roomTitle, maxUserCount, roomType) values(#{roomNo}, #{roomTitle}, #{maxUserCount}, #{roomType})

merge into chatRoomJoin c using dual on (c.roomNo = #{roomNo} and c.userid = #{userid}) when not matched then insert (roomNo, userid, isWatching, lastReadMsgNo) values(#{roomNo}, #{userid}, #{isWatching}, #{lastReadMsgNo})
mapper.select: select * from chatRoom order by roomNO desc
select * from chatMessage where roomNo = #{roomNo} and sendTime >= (select joinDate from chatRoomJoin where roomNo = #{roomNo} and userid = #{userid}) order by msgNo asc
mapper.insert: insert into chatMessage(msgNo, roomNo, senderId, messageContent) values(seqMsgNo.nextval, #{roomNo}, #{senderId}, #{messageContent})
mapper.update: update chatRoomJoin set lastReadMsgNo = (select MAX(msgNo) from chatMessage where roomNo = #{roomNo}) where roomNo = #{roomNo} and isWatching = 'Y'
update chatRoomJoin set isWatching = #{isWatching} where roomNo = #{roomNo} and userid = #{userid}
mapper.select: select count(*) from chatRoomJoin where userid = #{userid}
